ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Human Rights. This course will begin by exploring the politics of defining human rights, focusing on variations in conceptions of human rights both across time and across cultures. Subsequently, we will cover the politics of enforcing human rights standards by studying international institutions including international law, the United Nations, the International Criminal Court, humanitarian military intervention, and non-governmental organizations. Finally, we will examine these themes in detail using several case studies of human rights violations. This course is suitable for freshmen.
